title: Closed-boundary restriction of the intrinsic extension by zero
statement: For a closed immersion z into the affine base and complementary quasi-compact open e, the intrinsic extension by zero from the clopen open h over the open complement restricts to a zero module on the base change of z.

source.place: Tags 09AH and 09BN, disjoint open-closed restriction and base change.

proof.text: Base change z and e to P, identify the resulting closed and open immersions, and use the complement equation to show that the pullback of the extension by zero is zero.

lean.statement: theorem proEtale_proper_boundary_extension_restricts_zero (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {Z E P U : Scheme.{u}} (z : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsClosedImmersion z] (e : E ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsOpenImmersion e] [QuasiCompact e] (hcomplement : Set.range e = (Set.range z)ᶜ) (p : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsProper p] (h : U ⟶ pullback p e) [IsOpenImmersion h] (hclosed : IsClosed (Set.range h)) [QuasiCompact (h ≫ pullback.fst p e)] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (J : proEtaleRingModules U (proEtaleConstantRing U A)) [Injective J] : IsZero ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A (pullback.snd z p)).obj ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero (h ≫ pullback.fst p e) A).obj J))
